title_en: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Four
body_ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم السؤال 1 : الاستشكال الذي يحصل عندما يحفظ الإنسان الشاطبية والدرة في الالتباس بالألف والباء والجيم والدال ونحو ذلك من الرموز المشتركة كيف يتخلص منه الإنسان ؟ الجواب : إنما يتخلص منه بإتقان حفظ القصيدتين ، أن يحفظ كل واحدة منهما حفظا محكما بحيث لا تلتبس عليه بالأخرى ، لأن الالتباس إنما يقع عند عدم إتقان الحفظ ، إذا حفظت هذه وحفظت هذه وكان حفظك غير محكم تتداخل عليك وتلتبس ، ولذلك كثير من الذين يحفظون الشاطبية والدرة اليوم إذا امتحنت أحدهم بالمفاجأة فسألته عن بيت هل هو من الشاطبية أو من الدرة التبس عليهم الأمر ، وهذا الذي يقتضي الوقوع في خطئ مثل هذا ، ويمكن التخلص من ذلك أيضا بإتقان القراءة نفسها فمن كان متقنا للسبع أو لإحداها عرف ما كان من الدرة مما كان من الشاطبية ..
body_en: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving. Question 1: The difficulty that arises when a person memorises al-Shatibiyyah and al-Durrah, in the confusion between alif, bāʾ, jīm, dāl and the like of the shared symbols — how does a person rid himself of it? The answer: He rids himself of it only by mastering the memorisation of the two poems — that he memorise each of the two with a firm memorisation, such that the one is not confused for him with the other; because confusion arises only where the memorisation has not been mastered. If you have memorised this one and memorised that one and your memorisation is not firm, they run into one another for you and become confused. For that reason, with many of those who memorise al-Shatibiyyah and al-Durrah today, if you test one of them by surprise and ask him about a line — whether it is from al-Shatibiyyah or from al-Durrah — the matter becomes confused for them; and this is what leads to falling into an error of this kind. It is possible to be rid of that, also, by mastering the reading itself: whoever has mastered the seven readings, or one of them, knows what belongs to al-Durrah as against what belongs to al-Shatibiyyah..

flags.note: The rumūz are the single letters by which the two didactic poems abbreviate the names of the reciters and their transmitters; the same letter stands for different reciters in the two poems, which is the source of the confusion the questioner describes. The Sheikh does not explain this, and no explanation has been added to the English. A reviewer may wish to add an editorial footnote for readers outside the qirāʾāt tradition.
